annotations.text:
Flow of a game, from left to right: create the room, wait for the others, play the round, see the results. Working name: WordRush (placeholder).
The source of truth for rules and points is in the project's context/ folder.

Points per round = 1 for every 1% of the initial time left when you solve, −3 per extra attempt, +25/+15/+10 for the first three, +10 for keeping the hint, minimum 20 for solving. Without solving: 5 per green, maximum 20.
When someone solves: −5 s to everyone still playing.
Below: the same game screen on mobile and in dark mode. Dark mode is an alternative, so one can be picked as the main one.
